notes: A progress bar for the GPU wait. Waiting minutes on a cold start with nothing but a spinner was the last indignity — the typing bubble now grows a progress bar during photo-reads that fills against the wait budget, the caption shows elapsed against total ('2:14 / 10:00'), and every few seconds the app asks the endpoint what is actually happening and says it in plain words: 'waiting for a GPU', 'GPU booting — loading the model', 'GPU busy — 2 jobs ahead of yours', 'GPU is reading your photo'. When a confirmed boot earns a bigger budget, the bar re-scales instead of lying. You always know which phase the wait is in and how much runway remains.
